parsed_json.up: Select compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, compound_records, and compound_structures. Filter for target CHEMBL4439, standard_type IC50, standard_units nM, and require canonical_smiles to be present and pubmed_id_or_doi to be non-null. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
